افتضحن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَضَحْنَ (iftaḍaḥna) /if.ta.dˤaħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
# اِفْتَضِحْنَ (iftaḍiḥna) /if.ta.dˤiħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِفْتَضَحَ (iftaḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
